slides.hook: Balogun's *brace* lit up the hosts' opener.
slides.note: USA's first brace on this stage since 1930.

slides.headline: Two up inside half an hour
slides.body: An own goal set the tone — Bobadilla turned McKennie's cutback into his own net on 7. Balogun made it two on 31, sweeping in Pulisic's pass. Paraguay were *chasing before they'd settled.*

slides.headline: Balogun's stunner ends the contest
slides.body: On the stroke of halftime, Balogun lifted a finish into the top corner — his second, the hosts' third. Mauricio pulled one back on 73, but Reyna had the *last word* deep in stoppage time.

slides.context: Lukic put Bosnia ahead on 21. Sub Larin levelled on 78 — *Canada's first point* at the tournament, and the first host to draw its opener since 2010.

slides.note: Tonight: Brazil vs Morocco — plus 3 more openers.

stories.big: Balogun's *brace* lit up the hosts' opener.
USA 4-1. Not a card in sight. Grade: *A.*
